nom: MAC Hyper Real Skincanvas Waterlight Cream Moisturizer

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who describes it as dry like the Sahara desert, mostly report all-day hydration without oiliness or greasiness, though a couple with combination-dry skin found it not quite hydrating enough used alone and prefer layering it under a heavier cream.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin say the lightweight formula doesn't clog pores or add extra shine by the end of the day, though it may feel a touch too dewy for very oily skin worn without powder.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including those who describe themselves as acne-prone, generally report no clogged pores or new breakouts and a good balance of hydration without excess oil, though one found it insufficient as a standalone moisturizer for her combo/dry skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including several who are rosacea-prone or fragrance-sensitive, mostly report no irritation, redness or burning despite the product containing fragrance, though one reviewer experienced a slight burning sensation.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers using it consistently over a week or more report visibly diminished fine lines and smile lines, along with tighter-looking pores; no reviewer reports fine lines or firmness worsening.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe lasting, visible hydration, with several noting their skin still feels moisturized many hours after applying, including through cold winter days. A recurring minority say the hydration doesn't hold up on its own: a few report it wearing off by midday or not being enough for drier skin without layering a heavier cream on top.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers managing rosacea say their redness looked calmer with regular use, and one rosacea-prone, sensitive-skin reviewer had no irritation, redness or burning at all. Against this, one reviewer experienced a slight burning sensation and mild irritation from the formula.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers say their skin barrier feels stronger or better protected with continued use, though one reviewer felt the barrier-like layer faded quickly, leaving her skin feeling unprotected again by midday.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers, including several who describe themselves as acne-prone or combination, report no breakouts or clogged pores even with daily or twice-daily use. Against this, one reviewer says it started clogging her pores after a few uses, and another senses some clogging without it actually causing breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers worried about added shine generally find it doesn't make their skin oilier by the end of the day, even on combination or oily-leaning skin, though one reviewer notes it can feel a touch too dewy for very oily skin without setting powder on top.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight texture that absorbs without greasiness
Layers under makeup with no pilling
No pump makes the jar hard to dispense
A little product goes a long way

extraits.titre: Solid cream, may irritate certain skin types.
extraits.texte: I believe this is a solid cream with a good, almost airy, texture. Not too heavy, but still moisturizing with a neutral fragrance. Unfortunately, there was something in it that seemed to irritate my skin, which is not an issue I've had with other facial moisturizers. It wasn't major irritation, but caused a very slight burning feeling. I think this would be a good cream for most people, but may not be safe for those with sensitive skin. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

The MAC Hyper Real Skin Canvas Water Light Cream has a beautiful, lightweight texture and gives the skin a smooth, hydrated look without feeling heavy or greasy. It layers well under makeup and definitely creates a nice, healthy glow. Unfortunately, after a few uses I noticed it started to clog my pores, which was disappointing because I really wanted to love it. That said, I think it could work great for people who aren't prone to congestion. Overall, it's a high-quality product with a lovely finish, just not a perfect match for my skin type. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes

This cream is lightly hydrating and sinks in quickly, leaving a slight film of Dimethicone that helps prep skin for makeup. I'm a huge fan of silicone-based primers for the same reasons this cream works so well under makeup. It smooths over texture and has a blurring effect that's very flattering even on its own. I actually used it in place of a my primer for a few days and my foundation looked and wore just as good as usual. As a moisturizer it wasn't as hydrating as my combo/dry skin likes. I preferred layering it over my usual day cream for extra moisture and the texture-smoothing benefits. I think if you have oily or true combo skin this cream by itself would be sufficient, but overall I enjoyed it more as a part of my makeup routine than as a new skincare staple! The added fragrance is light and cause me irritation, but it's unnecessary and might be an issue if you have sensitive skin. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

My skin is seriously try like the Sahara desert and this moisturizer has came in handy to be my savior more times than one I was first introduced to this product when I went to get my make up done at the MAC store they asked me what my skin dry or oily. I replied it was dry like the Sahara desert, and my stylist applied the hyperreal moisturizer before she begin to apply my primer and make up and ever since then I have been obsessed with this product, it moisturizes your skin without leaving oiliness or an overcast. It's lightweight and lightly fragrance perfect base for your makeup Or skin care routine.

extraits.titre: My go-to for prepping skin for makeup!
extraits.texte: This is my new favorite! MAC Hyper Real SkinCanvas Waterlight Cream is absolutely amazing! The texture is airy-light, melting right into my skin, fully absorbing without any greasy or oily shine that I hate. The peony scent is just wow- so gorgeous, it elevates the whole experience.✨ It feels incredibly lightweight yet hydrating. My skin looks so smooth afterwards. It creates the perfect smooth base, blurring my pores and prepping my skin before I apply foundation. My makeup actually looks 10x better and lasts longer too. The results have been amazing, my skin is not only smoother it's also softer and has a radiant glow. My large pores and harsh smile lines have since diminished. And my skin tone looks more even. If your prone to breakouts from skincare products not to worry this moisturizer is extremely gentle, it hasn't clogged my pores or caused any breakouts even with multiple uses per day. Honestly my skin has never looked better! If you want a moisturizer that improves your skin and layers beautifully under makeup, I definitely recommend this! I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review, and I've really enjoyed using it. The MAC Hyper Real SkinCanvas™ Waterlight Cream HA3 Moisturizer feels very lightweight on the skin and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy. I have rosacea-prone, sensitive skin, and I was happy to find that it didn't cause any irritation or redness, not even any burning sensation, which is very rare for me. It gives my skin a nice hydrated feel while still feeling breathable, which makes it comfortable for everyday use. Overall, this is a great moisturizer if you're looking for something gentle, lightweight, and suitable for sensitive skin. I would definitely consider repurchasing it.

I am more on the oily skin/combination side and the fact that this is truly light weight is AMAZING! It has Niacinamide in it which reduces the appearance of pores. Speaking of pores, I don't have to worry about it clogging my pores is which is great! The hyaluronic acid helps with my combination skin, so this a 3-in-1 for me. I love the smell of it and I've been using it in the am followed with sunscreen. It gives me an effortless beauty look. 10/10 recommend!
